    joint_base_gantry = sandbox.add_joint(gantry, base, (5.0, 10.0), type='rigid')

    joint_slider = sandbox.add_joint(base, slider, (5.0, 10.0), 
                                    type='slider', axis=(0, -1), lower_translation=0, upper_translation=8, 
                                    enable_motor=True, motor_speed=0, max_motor_force=5000)
    sandbox.set_fixed_rotation(slider, fixed=True)  # Prevent slider rotation
    
    # Create finger beams and pivot joints
    # Fingers are attached to the slider at offset positions to allow grasping
    finger1_x = 5.0 - 0.1
    finger1 = sandbox.add_beam(x=finger1_x, y=10.0, width=0.2, height=0.2, density=1.0)
    joint_finger1 = sandbox.add_joint(slider, finger1, (finger1_x, 10.0), 
                                      type='pivot', enable_motor=True, motor_speed=0, 
                                      max_motor_torque=100)
    
    finger2_x = 5.0 + 0.1
    finger2 = sandbox.add_beam(x=finger2_x, y=10.0, width=0.2, height=0.2, density=1.0)

                                      type='pivot', enable_motor=True, motor_speed=0, 
                                      max_motor_torque=100)
    
    # Set higher friction for better grip
    sandbox.set_material_properties(finger1, friction=0.8)
    sandbox.set_material_properties(finger2, friction=0.8)
    
    return {
